import csv, statistics
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path('/work/inputs/art_fa2f37f0f7c14249b7c923fe4e2facb0/numbers.csv')
with input_path.open(newline='') as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
print('rows:', rows)
values = [float(r['value']) for r in rows]
count = len(values)
total = sum(values)
mean = statistics.mean(values)
print('count:', count)
print('sum:', total)
print('mean:', mean)

outdir = Path('/work/outputs')
outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

with (outdir/'summary.csv').open('w', newline='') as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(['count', 'sum', 'mean'])
    w.writerow([count, total, mean])

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 3), dpi=100)
ax.bar(range(1, len(values) + 1), values)
ax.set_xlabel('row')
ax.set_ylabel('value')
ax.set_title('Actual values')
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(outdir/'chart.png')
print('saved summary.csv and chart.png')
